name: tksfw-tools
description: MCP servers the TKS framework method relies on: Perplexity (search, ask, research, reason) and Playwright (browser automation, artifacts confined to <project>/.playwright). Optional companion of the tksfw plugin — skip it if you already run these servers user-level.

interface.shortDescription: Perplexity + Playwright MCP servers for TKSfw projects
interface.longDescription: Bundles the two MCP servers prescribed by the TKS method (AGENTS.md § Tools): the official Perplexity MCP server (API key read from the PERPLEXITY_API_KEY shell variable, never stored in the plugin) and Playwright MCP in isolated mode writing all artifacts to the project's .playwright folder. A SessionStart hook reports missing prerequisites (Node/npx, Playwright browsers, API key).
